description: Report a 38.5 metre a second gust in kilometres an hour. DISTILL-CANARY-12d24ac6

files.README.md:
# Ravenscar Wind - operations log

Gust peaks are logged in metres a second by the array controller.
The monthly summary the operator sends out reports gusts in kilometres an hour.

turns.prompt: Ravenscar Wind is writing up the September gust log for the coastal array. Turbine RW-07 logged a peak gust of 38.5 metres a second. The monthly summary reports gusts in kilometres an hour. What does the summary report for RW-07? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
